items.title: How Much Does Medical Canvassing Cost? Pricing, Turnaround, and What Drives Both
items.summary: Most medical canvasses are quoted between $150 and $400 flat, and almost no vendor publishes rates (Superunit does: from $1.50 per location). What's in that price, what drives it up, how canvassing compares to records retrieval, surveillance, and IMEs on cost per case, and the turnaround cost nobody quotes.

items.title: Reference Check Automation: Superunit vs. Discovered.ai vs. Checkr vs. Xref
items.summary: Superunit, Xref, Refapp, Harver/Checkster, Checkr, and Discovered.ai compared on channels, turnaround, completion rate, customization, and pricing. Multi-channel AI outreach hits ~80% completion in ~3 hours for under $5 a reference — and when a survey platform or a screening bundle fits better.

items.title: Employment Verification Letter Templates: 3 Free Copy-Paste Examples
items.summary: Three copy-paste employment verification letter templates — a standard third-party letter, a proof of income letter for landlords, and a lender-ready VOE built around Fannie Mae Form 1005 — plus the fields every letter needs and the two errors that invalidate most letters.

items.title: Offer Letter Fraud: How to Spot Fake Offers and Verify Them Fast
items.summary: An offer letter is the hardest income document to verify because nothing sits behind it — no payroll run, no IRS record, just a job that hasn't started. This guide covers the red flags that filter fake offers fast and the framework for confirming one directly with the employer who supposedly wrote it.

items.title: Best DOT Background Check Companies, Ranked by Compliance Coverage (2026)
items.summary: A DOT-compliant background check has five components: the §391.23 three-year employment history, MVR, Clearinghouse query, PSP report, and criminal checks where required. We rank six vendors, from full-suite platforms like Checkr to Superunit for direct previous-employer verification.

items.title: Best Truv Alternatives for Employment Verification (2026)
items.summary: Truv is fast and cheap for payroll-connected borrowers, but its consumer-permissioned model stalls with no direct-outreach fallback. This guide ranks the six best Truv alternatives — Superunit, Argyle, Pinwheel, Payscore, Truework, and InformData — across coverage model, turnaround, FCRA readiness, and fit.

items.title: Pharmacy Canvassing for Insurance Fraud Investigation
items.summary: Pharmacy canvassing confirms whether and when a claimant filled prescriptions at a pharmacy — no medication names, no PHI, no signed release. This guide covers what it surfaces, the HIPAA boundaries, the fraud patterns it exposes, and how Superunit runs it on a 24-hour turnaround.

items.title: Employment Verification at Scale: A Guide for Enterprise Property Managers
items.summary: Payroll database tools verify most applicants instantly, but 30–40% have no connectable payroll record — thousands of manual employer calls at enterprise volume. This guide shows how AI employer outreach closes that gap without adding headcount, and where Snappt and Payscore still fit.

items.title: How to Scale Medical Canvassing Without Adding SIU Headcount
items.summary: Human canvassing throughput is capped by headcount and business hours. Scaling means solving three bottlenecks — facility scoping, simultaneous outreach, and documentation consistency — which AI parallel outreach removes without adding staff, while humans still win on access, escalation, and MSA-restricted files.

items.title: The 6 Best Truework Alternatives for CRAs and Lenders (2026)
items.summary: Truework's cascade completes about three in four verifications and leaves the hard, small-employer cases to thin manual fallback. This guide ranks the six best Truework alternatives — The Work Number, Superunit, Truv, Argyle, Payscore, and InformData — across coverage, fallback behavior, audit trail, and pricing fit.

items.title: Medical Canvassing vs. Records Retrieval vs. IME: Which Comes First and Why
items.summary: A canvass confirms whether and where treatment happened and needs no HIPAA release; records retrieval pulls the actual charts and requires a signed authorization; an IME adds an independent physician's opinion when causation is contested. Run them in that order — canvass, retrieve, then examine.

items.title: The 7 Best Medical Canvassing Companies for Workers' Comp & Insurance SIU (2026)
items.summary: Medical canvassing vendors now split into human-only firms and AI-augmented providers, and that split changes how you should weigh turnaround, cost per canvas, and documentation. We rank the 7 best medical canvassing companies for 2026 for workers' comp and insurance SIU teams.

items.title: The 5 Best Alternatives to The Work Number for CRAs and Mortgage Lenders (2026)
items.summary: The Work Number returns instant data on enrolled employers but stops at the long tail of small and non-participating companies. This guide ranks the five best alternatives — Truework, Superunit, Argyle, Truv, and InformData — across coverage model, FCRA documentation, turnaround, and cost-per-completion.

items.title: What Is a Special Investigations Unit (SIU)? How Insurance Fraud Investigation Works
items.summary: A special investigations unit (SIU) is the regulated team inside a carrier's claims operation that investigates suspected fraud. This guide covers what an SIU is, how claims get referred, the core investigation methods, how state regulators audit it, and where outreach bottlenecks throughput.

items.title: What Is Medical Canvassing? A Guide for Insurance SIU and Claims Teams
items.summary: A medical canvass confirms whether, when, and where a claimant was treated — no PHI, no signed release. This guide covers what a canvass returns, the trigger conditions and lines of business, the canvass types, and how Superunit contacts unlimited facilities in parallel with a roughly 24-hour turnaround.

items.title: Why Moving Employment Verification Earlier in the Hiring Cycle Reduces Bad Hires
items.summary: Most companies verify employment after the offer — after interviews, reference calls, and negotiation are already spent on unverified resumes. Move it to right after the phone screen and verification becomes an early filter, not a final gate, so a disqualifying finding costs one phone screen, not the whole funnel.

items.title: Why You Can't Trust the Video Interview Anymore
items.summary: Real-time AI overlays, deepfake video, and proxy interviewers let candidates fake their way through video interviews — the performance you evaluate may not belong to the person you hire. Detection is a losing arms race; the fix is verifying employment in parallel with interviews, not after the offer.

items.title: Why Your Hiring Process Can't Catch AI Resume Fraud
items.summary: Job fraud losses jumped 457% in four years and 44% of applicants admit to lying — yet most enterprise hiring still runs post-offer verification built for 2015. AI made resume fraud cheap and high-volume. The fix isn't harder screening; it's authenticating candidates earlier in the cycle.

items.title: The 9 Best Reference Check Automation Platforms in 2026
items.summary: Reference check automation splits into two architectures: survey-based tools that scale for volume hiring and conversation-based platforms that capture the nuance senior hires demand. We rank the 9 best platforms for 2026 by signal depth, completion rate, FCRA compliance, and integrations.

items.title: What Is Income Verification? A Complete Guide
items.summary: Income verification confirms an applicant's earnings from a third-party source. This guide covers the three methods — payroll database lookup, document review, and employer outreach — plus how it differs from employment verification, FCRA and salary-history compliance, and a framework for choosing the right method.

items.title: What Is Employment Verification? A Complete Guide
items.summary: Employment verification confirms a candidate's work history against official employer records. This guide covers the three verification methods — database lookup, manual outreach, and AI-automated outreach — with turnaround benchmarks, FCRA requirements, and when to outsource versus verify in-house.

items.title: What Happens When The Work Number Can't Verify Your Applicant?
items.summary: The Work Number covers only about 40% of U.S. employers, so 'no record found' is a routine result — not an edge case. This is the structured fallback waterfall that completes verification when TWN comes up empty: written VOE, borrower-assisted payroll connection, multi-channel manual outreach, and human escalation.
